integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, minimalist black line animation on a flat, digitally pure-white canvas with no texture, no gradient, no shadow, and no depth. Use minimalist two-dimensional black line animation. Show the same consistent stick figure with a hollow circular head, occasional simple line expressions, no detailed facial features, no hair, no clothing, no filled body, stable proportions, connected line limbs, and uniform medium line weight. Exactly two arms and two legs are visible per figure. Each limb appears only in its current pose: raising or lowering the right arm replaces that arm's previous line, never leaving a resting arm beneath an active arm. The figure stays black; accent colors affect only props and graphic effects. Three identical stick figures appear in this segment, all built to that same description. A static medium shot frames the same white floor. The center figure holds the warm-gold wine vessel with the short curved handle in his left hand; the right-hand figure's line arm slams down onto the vessel and pulls it away with a fast, sharp motion that shakes the red wine inside. The center figure's line tip freezes in mid-air, and one half-drawn electric-blue leg hangs from his snake. An off-screen adult male narrator with a warm, clean baritone and calm, restrained delivery (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Another man's snake is done.</d> while all figures stay silent with their simple line mouths completely closed and no character dialogue occurs. The camera holds a static shot. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of the right-hand figure. He tips the gold vessel to his mouth and leans his head back; a thin vivid-red line of wine flows from the vessel mouth into his mouth and is swallowed. The camera pans left with large amplitude at fast speed to the center figure's empty left hand, which opens and closes around nothing, while the half-drawn electric-blue leg detaches from his snake and drops onto the white floor. The same narrator (S1) continues in the same off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] He drinks the wine. The prize was yours, and you kept drawing.</d> while the figures stay silent with their mouths completely closed. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed to a high wide shot. The center figure stands alone at the center of the white floor beside his electric-blue snake with two legs; the loose extra strokes crumble into a short random blue squiggle; the right-hand figure walks out of frame right carrying the gold vessel; large empty white negative space remains at the bottom and right of the 16:9 frame. The same narrator (S1) continues in the same off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Where do you draw feet?</d> while the center figure stays silent with his simple line mouth completely closed. Throughout the segment the canvas stays flat pure white with no texture, gradient, shadow, or depth; no on-screen text, letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, signs, logos, or watermarks; no speech bubbles or dialogue boxes; no photorealistic people, faces, or 3D rendering; no extra limbs, fingers, detached hands, or additional figures beyond the three.

overall_soundscape: A flat slap lands on the metal vessel with a dull knock, followed by liquid pouring and a single swallow. One small dry snap is heard as the extra blue stroke detaches and drops onto the floor, and footsteps then walk away across the bare floor and fade out.

non_diegetic_music: The same sparse piano pattern continues at identical tempo and instrumentation but with fewer notes, thinning to one isolated low piano note that decays into silence by the end of the segment.
